gia_24h.quote: Report the accident to your Insurer within 24 Hours or by the next working day

gia_other.point: Take vehicle, damaged or not, to approved reporting centre or authorised workshop within 24 hours
gia_other.quote: Report and take your vehicle, damaged or not, to the approved reporting centre or authorized workshop within 24 hours.
all motorists now have to report to their insurers any accident, no matter how small.
The MCF states that the end of the next working day is the timeframe for reporting.

gia_other.point: Information to take at the scene (incl. photo)
gia_other.quote: NRIC, name, telephone number, address, insurer & digital photo of accident.
Take photos of the scene of the accident and the damages to all vehicles

gia_other.point: Do not move vehicle before photos
gia_other.quote: Do not move your vehicle before taking photographs of the accident scene.

gia_other.point: Police report is not an insurer report
gia_other.quote: Filing a Traffic Police report is not equivalent to making a report to your insurer.

gia_other.point: Use insurer's authorised workshop for repairs
gia_other.quote: you should go to an authorised workshop of your insurer for repairs (even if you are claiming against the other party).
motorists are strongly advised not to have any dealings with unauthorised tow-truck operators at the scene of accident.
The ARC will assist you to complete and submit the final Accident Report.

gia_other.point: Documents to bring: GIA MCF page lists none; insurer pages vary (FWD: driving licence, NRIC, certificate of insurance, police report, photos, witness reports; AIG: NRIC/ID, driver's licence, company stamp)
GIA does not publish reporting centre list on the pages read; the MCF page says refer to own insurer. GIA 'List of Motor Insurers' PDF URLs found by search returned a 404 page when fetched.

cases: Injury where at least one person was taken to hospital from the scene by ambulance, or any party was injured and received outpatient medical leave of 3 days or more
A pedestrian or cyclist is involved
spf_police_cases.timeframe_quote: UNVERIFIED on the SPF page: it states no deadline. GIA page says Traffic Police report 'as soon as possible or within 24 hours of the accident'.
spf_police_cases.how: Online via SPF e-services 'Traffic Accident Report' (SingPass and email address needed), or in person at any police station.
